articles.title: Why I Built This Site
articles.summary: Why I created an independent home for my writing and videos.
articles.body:
I wanted an independent home for my writing, analysis, and videos.

## Goals

- Share long-form analysis
- Explain complex ideas clearly
- Build a direct relationship with my audience

This site brings my articles, X commentary, and YouTube work together in one place.
